english.meaning: crumbly or falling apart in texture, said of cooked meat
english.note: This meaning is less certain: it was read from a few recorded conversations.

exampleSentences.english: Or curry chicken, cooked until the meat’s so tender the bones fall apart.
exampleSentences.traditional: 或者係咖喱雞。揦到啲肉呢，嗰啲骨都散埋嗰啲呢。
